title: fix(service-automation): the flow toggle records which admin switched a packaged flow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTXjaSjCiT9wP1UtogZiA8r)_

Fixes #26474. This is the flow-toggle half. The action and security halves landed in #26551, and the contract's `caller` parameter on `IAutomationService.toggleFlow` landed in #26545 (closing #26506). Seat ruling `6434876664`, letter A, item 2; claim `6437525635`.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 管理员通过 `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle` 关掉或打开一个打包的 flow 时,激活台账行的 `created_by` / `updated_by` 和对应审计行的 `user_id` / `actor` 现在记的是这位管理员,不再是空。至此 #26474 的三个开关门(action、安全目录、flow)都能说出是谁操作的。
- **为什么改:** flow 门经由 `IAutomationService.toggleFlow` 写台账,以前这个契约带不了调用者,只能用不带用户的系统身份写入。spec 卡 #26506 已在 #26545 补上 `caller` 参数,本 PR 把它接通。
- **风险与回滚:** 写入仍是提权写(权限不变),只多带了用户 id;`caller` 只取 `userId`,不带职位、权限、租户。没有调用者的写入照旧用系统身份。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-definitions.ts`(`flowActivationWriteOptions` 与写入处)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/activation-gate.ts`(`activationCaller`)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 toggle 门。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/activation-ledger-actor.dogfood.test.ts`(先按 CI 建好 dogfood 依赖闭包),预期 7/7 通过,flow 用例的台账行与审计行都写着登录管理员的 id。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/runtime`:** the flow toggle door calls `toggleFlow(name, enabled, activationCaller(context))`. The new `activationCaller(context)` in `domains/activation-gate.ts` returns `{ userId }` from the caller's execution context, or `{}` when there is no user. It carries nothing else: no positions, permissions or tenant. The door's two authority gates have already judged the caller, and the contract says `caller` is attribution only.
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`:** `AutomationEngine.toggleFlow(name, enabled, caller?)` implements the contract's `caller` and hands it to the moved body in `flow-definitions.ts`. There, `flowActivationWriteOptions(caller)` builds the ledger write's options: `{ context: { isSystem: true, positions: [], permissions: [], userId } }`. That is the store's own grant-less system context plus the caller's id, and only `caller.userId` is read. No id (no caller, `{}` or an empty string) means no options, so the store keeps writing under its own system context and the row names nobody. `FlowActivationStore.setActive(row, options?)` takes the optional `MetadataActivationWriteOptions` from `@objectstack/core`, the same channel #26551 gave the shared store. `ObjectStoreFlowActivationStore` already inherits that behaviour from core's `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore`.

**Mechanism.** It is the same as the other two doors. The elevation is kept, because the ledger object is engine-owned and only an elevated write reaches it. The caller's id rides in that context, so the engine stamps `created_by` / `updated_by` from `userId` and the audit plugin records `user_id` / `actor` from the same session. No actor is stamped by hand. The flow door does not reuse `activationWriteContext` (the full caller context, elevated), because the contract narrows `caller` to `userId` and the automation service builds the context on its side of the seam.

**Every `toggleFlow` caller.** `git grep` over `*.ts` / `*.tsx` outside `packages/spec` finds one in-repo caller, the runtime door in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`, which now passes its caller. There is no internal caller without a user. `ui/`, `apps/`, `examples/` and `packages/client` call no `toggleFlow`.

## Why

Card #26474 (QA source #26468): on a stock showcase, a signed-in admin switched off a packaged flow, and the ledger row's `created_by` / `updated_by` and its audit row's `user_id` / `actor` were null. The engine wrote through the ledger store's constant system context, and `toggleFlow(name, enabled)` had no way to say who asked.

## Tests

Red first, measured on `main` `1080f074` source with the new tests in the tree and a build of that source:

| Suite | On `main` | After the fix |
|:--|:--|:--|
| service-automation `flow-toggle-caller-attribution.test.ts` (new, 5 cases) | 2 failed (the caller's id never reached the store's options); the 3 unattributed controls (no caller, `{}`, empty id) passed | 5/5 pass |
| runtime `automation-toggle-caller.test.ts` (new, 2 cases) | 2 failed (`toggleFlow` was called with two arguments) | 2/2 pass |
| dogfood `activation-ledger-actor.dogfood.test.ts`, new case "a packaged flow" (`showcase_scheduled_digest`, off then on; ledger row and audit row) | 2 failed (`expected null to be` the admin id); the 5 action and position cases passed | 7/7 pass |

Existing pins that read `toggleFlow`'s two arguments now take `expect.anything()` as the third (`http-dispatcher.test.ts` and 7 files under `packages/runtime/src/domains/`).

<details><summary>Ablations (one behaviour, one mutation each; every restore proved blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)</summary>

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against the source-level suites:

1. `flow-definitions.ts`: the write's options replaced by `undefined`. Service suite: 2 failed, 3 passed (the controls).
2. `automation.ts`: the door passes `undefined` for `caller`. Door suite: 2 failed.
3. `activation-gate.ts`: `activationCaller` spreads the whole execution context into the caller. Door suite: 2 failed.
4. `flow-definitions.ts`: the write's context spreads the caller object (grants smuggled in). Service suite: 1 failed (the "only the id crosses" case).

</details>

Package suites at head `f381e8f4`, under the verify lock:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 458 files, 7430 passed, 19 skipped.
- service-automation `vitest run`: 212 files, 2730 passed.
- `typecheck` for service-automation and runtime: exit 0.
- Dogfood `activation-ledger-actor` and `packaged-activation-ledger-reach`: 2 files, 18 passed, on a rebuilt tree.

The dogfood regression gate does not run on PRs or in the merge queue. The dogfood numbers above are the local run.

## Declarations

- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`.** `AutomationEngine.toggleFlow`'s new `caller` implements an already-declared contract parameter, which on its own would be `no`. But `FlowActivationStore`, exported from `@objectstack/service-automation`'s entry, gains an optional `options` parameter on `setActive`, so the package's published surface widens. A store that implements the one-argument form still type-checks and keeps working. `activationCaller` is not exported from `@objectstack/runtime`'s entry. This is the same measure #26551 used for the shared store.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`.** Nothing a metadata author writes changes.
